long_biography.plain_text:
NVR’s business joined home construction with mortgage services, but its distinguishing discipline lay in limiting land exposure and standardizing operations across regional brands. Dwight Schar launched Northern Virginia Land and Homes in 1980, added mortgage banking and acquired Ryan Homes, creating the platform now known as NVR. That combination made residential real estate the engine of his fortune.

After retiring from NVR’s board in 2022, Schar continued to influence development through Comstock, where he is a strategic adviser, major shareholder and principal of Comstock Partners. His civic work focuses on institutions serving education and healthcare. Ashland carries his name on colleges of education and nursing, George Mason on its School of Policy and Government, and Inova on cancer and cardiovascular programs.
